question: To Oda-sensei. Why did you make a character like Kujaku?! We're going to have perverts like Sanada again! I like clean SBS!! no Mi
answer: I don't think you'll see perverts because of Kujaku. It's okay! I haven't seen postcards from Sanada this time! Peace and tranquility have come to the SBS at last! (cries)
name: Gomumera no Mi
